description: Replication Data for: Joint heat producer, network pipes, and substation optimization is a data set deposited in KU Leuven RDR by its authors Martin Sollich (Associatie KU Leuven). A dataset containing the structure and input parameters of the heat producers, network, and substations used in the test case of the PhD thesis of Martin Sollich for the joint heat producer, network pipes, and substation optimization. The optimization results can be replicated using the methodology and formulations described in the thesis. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. Formats: TXT, ZIP, CSV. Size stated: 1512. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
